primaryChecks.text: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
